fields.name: <:shield:865895492047470604> Right to Action
fields.value: Staff members reserve the right to warn, mute, kick, or ban any user at any time, without prior warning or notice, if they deem it necessary to protect the server.

fields.name: <:blue_pin:1216132453098459336> Evidence Provision
fields.value: Moderators are **not obligated** to provide users with screenshots, logs, or any other form of evidence regarding their infractions. Internal evidence standards are for staff use only.

embeds.title: <a:1456058683455963176:1456689407196139736> Alt Account Policy

fields.name: <:shield:865895492047470604> Detection & Verification
fields.value: Our verification system actively blocks alt accounts from joining by checking IP addresses and analyzing various other backend security factors.

fields.name: <:blue_pin:1216132453098459336> Strict Consequences

fields.name: <:link:908747871136919622> Approved Exceptions

embeds.title: <a:1456058683455963176:1456689407196139736> How to Appeal a Punishment
embeds.description: If you have received a moderation action (such as a mute, warning, or ban) and believe it was unjust, you can submit a formal appeal for staff review.

fields.name: <:blue_pin:1216132453098459336> The Appeals Portal
fields.value:
All appeals must be submitted through our official platform. We do not accept appeals through any other channel.

**🔗 [Submit an Appeal Here](https://appeal.gg/s/1466990155020898413)**

fields.name: <:shield:865895492047470604> Important Guidelines
fields.value:
• **Do not** DM staff members about your punishment or appeal.
• **Do not** have friends or third parties submit an appeal on your behalf.
• Be patient. Staff will review your submission and provide a final, binding decision.

fields.name: <:link:908747871136919622> Zero Appeal Rights
fields.value: Please note that certain severe infractions—such as hate speech, CSAM, doxxing, and threats—carry **zero appeal rights** under any circumstances.

fields.name: DDOS

fields.name: EXT

fields.name: RWT
fields.value: Real World Trading: Attempting to buy, sell, or trade in-game items, accounts, or server currency for real-world money.

fields.name: SCA
fields.value: Trade Scamming: Defrauding another user during a trade, failing to uphold an agreed-upon deal, or using exploits to steal items.

fields.name: FARM
fields.value: Economy Farming: Spamming chat specifically to gain bot XP, or using automated macros/scripts to grind server currency.

fields.name: ALT-F
fields.value: Alt Farming: Funneling currency, daily rewards, or items from multiple alternative accounts to a main account.

fields.name: TKT1
fields.value: Ticket Spam: Repeatedly opening and closing support tickets or Modmail threads without a valid reason.

fields.value: Troll Tickets: Opening support tickets to post memes, waste staff time, or submit false reports.

fields.value: Staff Harassment: Insulting, threatening, or acting belligerent toward moderation staff within a private support ticket.

fields.name: RPT-S

fields.name: RPT-F
fields.value: False Reporting: Maliciously abusing the `/report` command or context menu to submit fabricated evidence or false claims against innocent users.

fields.name: NICK
fields.value: Using an inappropriate, offensive, or unpingable nickname/username that violates server guidelines.

fields.name: AVT
fields.value: Displaying a profile picture (avatar) or profile banner that contains NSFW, gory, or offensive imagery.

fields.name: STAT

fields.name: How to Submit an Appeal
fields.value:
**All appeals must be submitted here — no exceptions:**

**https://zepp.noxxbot.com/appeals/1466990155020898413**

> 👢 DMs to staff — discarded. Your penalty may be extended.
> 👢 Public arguments — immediate escalation of the existing penalty.
> 👢 Proxy appeals (having someone else submit or argue for you) — voided.
> 👢 Re-submitting a closed appeal without new verifiable evidence — ignored.
> ✅ Be calm, factual, and concise. Include your case number from the DM you received.
> ✅ Appeals are reviewed by staff **not involved in the original action**.
> ✅ You will receive a response. Do not submit duplicate appeals while waiting.

fields.name: What Appeals Are and Are Not
fields.value:
**An appeal is a formal request for a staff error review.** It is not a negotiation, not a debate forum, and not a second chance to argue your position. The burden of demonstrating error rests entirely on the appellant.

- Accepted grounds: documented factual error, misidentification, technical malfunction
- Not accepted grounds: disagreement with the outcome, character references, "I won't do it again", emotional appeals, or new context that does not address the specific action

Hostile, demanding, or accusatory appeal submissions are denied immediately without review. Providing false information in an appeal results in a **permanent appeal blacklist** with no reinstatement.

fields.name: Non-Appealable Categories
fields.value:
The following are **never accepted under any circumstances:**

Hate speech (all forms) · CSAM (any form) · Doxxing & dox teasing · Real-world threats of violence or harm · Malware & phishing distribution

No context, intent, history, or relationship changes this. Unauthorised advertising and ban evasion are appealable only for documented staff error.

fields.name: Final Note
fields.value:
TSHE's moderation system exists to protect every member's ability to participate safely. Members who engage in good faith and treat others with basic respect will rarely see anything beyond a Tier 1 correction.
*When in doubt about whether something is allowed — ask a staff member before posting.*
Appeals: https://zepp.noxxbot.com/appeals/1466990155020898413

author.name: Punishment Guide — Page 8 of 10 · Zero-Tolerance Reference

footer.text: TSHE Punishment Guide · Page 8 of 10 · These bypass all tiers. No warning issued first. • tshe.f34rless.xyz/punish

fields.name: What Zero-Tolerance Means
fields.value:
These offences result in an **immediate permanent ban** the moment they are confirmed by any staff member. No prior warning. No Tier 1–4 process. Your account history, server standing, relationship with staff, or length of membership do not factor in at all.

The only accepted dispute route is the official appeal system, and only for verified, documented staff error. "I didn't mean it", "it was a joke", "I didn't know", and "context changes this" are not accepted grounds for any of these categories.

fields.name: No Appeal — Ever
fields.value:
- **Hate speech** — slurs, targeted discrimination, or content promoting hatred of any protected group in any form, including all censored, phonetic, or "ironic" variants
- **CSAM** — any form: shared, requested, referenced, described, generated, or implied
- **Doxxing** — sharing private information without consent. Dox teasing carries the identical penalty.
- **Real-world threats** — death threats or threats of violence directed at any person inside or outside the server
- **Malware & phishing** — distributing harmful files or credential-harvesting content in any channel or DM

These five carry **zero appeal rights under any circumstances whatsoever.** No context, intent, history, or relationship overrides this.

fields.name: Appealable Only for Documented Staff Error
fields.value:
- **Ban evasion** — rejoining on any alternate account during an active ban or mute
- **Unauthorised advertising** — promoting any server, service, or content without prior written staff approval
- **Discord ToS violations** — any behaviour violating Discord's Terms of Service simultaneously violates TSHE rules
- **Raid coordination** — organising, leading, or recruiting for a raid or mass harassment campaign
- **NSFW or shock content** — explicit imagery, gore, real-world violence footage shared in any channel
- **Internal leaks** — sharing moderation logs, staff communications, ticket content, or bot configuration data with any external party
- **Bot impersonation** — impersonating Noxx, Cattito, or Xyron with intent to deceive

Appeals for the above are accepted **only** if you can demonstrate documented staff error. Disagreement with the outcome is not grounds.

author.name: Punishment Guide — Page 9 of 10 · Warning Ladder & Escalation Table

footer.text: TSHE Punishment Guide · Page 9 of 10 · tshe.f34rless.xyz/punish

fields.name: Cumulative Warning Ladder
fields.value:
Penalties scale with **active (unexpired) warnings only**. Warnings expire after 6 months without further violations. Expired warnings do not count toward escalation but remain logged for reference.

```
1 active warning   →  Formal recorded warning (6-month expiry)
2 active warnings  →  1-hour server mute
3 active warnings  →  6-hour server mute
4 active warnings  →  24-hour server mute
5 active warnings  →  3-day server mute
6 active warnings  →  7-day server mute
7 active warnings  →  14-day temporary ban (appealable)
8+ active warnings →  Permanent ban (staff error appeal only)
```

> 🔇 Major offences bypass this ladder entirely — instant permanent action regardless of warning count.

fields.name: Warning Stacking Rules
fields.value:
- Warnings are logged to your permanent record the moment they are confirmed.
- Staff may issue multiple warnings for a single incident when multiple rules were violated simultaneously. There is no cap on warnings per incident.
- Severity may cause staff to skip tiers and apply a higher warning count directly. Tier skipping is always documented with reasoning.
- Warnings issued to alternate accounts are merged onto the primary account's record. Alt accounts do not receive a fresh slate.
- Multiple violations across different rule categories in a single session are processed as a combined escalation event, not as individual isolated incidents.

fields.name: Conduct After a Warning
fields.value:
- Warnings are final when issued. The correct response is to acknowledge and correct your behaviour.
- Publicly arguing, disputing, or complaining about a warning is treated as a **new violation** and results in an additional warning.
- Harassment of the warning-issuing staff member — in any channel, via DM, or on any external platform — results in an **immediate mute and escalated warning count**.
- Repeatedly asking staff to reduce, remove, or informally dismiss a warning via any channel results in an additional warning and disqualification from appeal eligibility for that case.

author.name: Punishment Guide — Page 6 of 10 · Tier 4 — During a Ban & Recidivism

footer.text: TSHE Punishment Guide · Page 6 of 10 · tshe.f34rless.xyz/punish

fields.name: What a Temporary Ban Means
fields.value:
- You are fully removed from TSHE. You cannot access any channel, send messages, view content, or interact with server infrastructure.
- You will receive a DM with your case number, reason, and duration. Save it — you need the case number to appeal.
- Your ban duration is not reduced for waiting quietly. Time served is the only path to return unless an appeal is accepted.
- If your ban expires and you rejoin, your **full moderation history is still active**. Returning is not a reset.

fields.name: Ban Evasion — Absolute Zero Tolerance
fields.value:
**Rejoining on any alternate account during an active temporary ban is ban evasion. No distinction is made between active participation and passive observation.**

- Joining on an alt to lurk, read, or observe → **permanent ban of all associated accounts**, reported to Discord Trust & Safety
- Joining on an alt to continue speaking → **permanent ban of all associated accounts**, reported to Discord Trust & Safety
- Having someone relay messages on your behalf → evasion. Same outcome.

"I forgot I was banned" is not a valid defence. "My friend let me use their account" is not a valid defence. All evasion bans carry **zero appeal rights**.

fields.name: Appealing a Temporary Ban
fields.value:
Temporary ban appeals may be submitted **48 hours after the ban is applied** at:

**https://zepp.noxxbot.com/appeals/1466990155020898413**

> 👢 Submitting before 48 hours → appeal voided, cooldown resets.
> 👢 DMing staff about the ban → appeal voided, ban may be extended.
> 👢 Public complaints → adds a Tier 2 warning logged against your return.
> ✅ Be factual, calm, and include your case number.
> ✅ Staff who were not involved in the original action will review your appeal.

author.name: Punishment Guide — Page 7 of 10 · Tier 5 — Permanent Ban

footer.text: TSHE Punishment Guide · Page 7 of 10 · tshe.f34rless.xyz/punish

fields.name: Tier 5 — Permanent Ban
fields.value: Permanent bans are the final outcome in TSHE's moderation system. They are issued for zero-tolerance violations or for sustained, wilful disregard of TSHE standards after exhausting all lower tiers. A permanent ban is **final by default.** The sole path to reversal is demonstrating a documented staff error — not disagreement with the outcome, not character references, not time served.

fields.name: Instant Permanent Ban — No Prior Warning Required
fields.value:
- **Hate speech** — slurs in any form: censored, phonetic, number-letter swapped, or "ironic" variants. Attempting to evade detection escalates the penalty further.
- **Real-world threats** — death threats, threats of violence or harm, or encouraging self-harm directed at any person
- **CSAM** — sharing, requesting, referencing, generating, or implying sexual content involving minors in any form. Reported to Discord T&S and relevant authorities.
- **Doxxing** — sharing private identifying information without explicit documented consent. Dox teasing carries the identical penalty.
- **Malware & phishing** — distributing executables, RATs, IP grabbers, credential harvesters, or phishing links
- **Ban evasion** — rejoining on any alternate account during an active ban or mute
- **AI-generated prohibited content** — using AI to bypass filters or produce prohibited material

fields.name: Escalation to Permanent Ban (via Tier 4)
fields.value:
- Third temporary ban for any reason
- Reoffending within 30 days of returning from a second temporary ban
- Sustained defiance of staff authority with no behavioural correction across multiple tiers

These bans are classified as escalation bans and carry limited appeal rights — see Page 10.

author.name: Punishment Guide — Page 4 of 10 · Tier 3 — During a Mute & Evasion

footer.text: TSHE Punishment Guide · Page 4 of 10 · tshe.f34rless.xyz/punish

fields.name: What a Mute Means
fields.value:
- You retain read-only access. You cannot send messages, add reactions, join voice channels, or interact with bots in any way.
- You will receive a DM with your case number, reason, and duration. Keep it — you will need it if you appeal.
- The mute period is not negotiable after issuance. It will not be reduced for good behaviour or requests during the mute. Submit an appeal if you believe it was issued in error.

fields.name: Mute Evasion — Zero Tolerance
fields.value:
**Communicating through indirect methods during a mute is classified as active evasion. Every method is treated identically.**

- Relaying messages through a friend, alt, or third party → mute duration **doubled**
- Using reactions, bot interactions, or indirect mentions to communicate → mute duration **doubled**
- Rejoining on an alternate account during an active mute → **immediate permanent ban of all associated accounts**, reported to Discord Trust & Safety. No warning. No appeal.

"I didn't know" is not a defence. Ignorance of evasion consequences is not mitigation.

fields.name: Appealing a Mute
fields.value:
Appeals must be submitted through the official system only:

**https://zepp.noxxbot.com/appeals/1466990155020898413**

> 👢 Do not DM staff. Your appeal will be voided and the mute may be extended.
> 👢 Do not complain in public channels. This adds a Tier 2 warning.
> ✅ Be factual, calm, and concise. Include your case number.
> ✅ Appeals are reviewed by staff who were not involved in the original action.

author.name: Punishment Guide — Page 5 of 10 · Tier 4 — Temporary Ban (Triggers)

footer.text: TSHE Punishment Guide · Page 5 of 10 · tshe.f34rless.xyz/punish

fields.name: Tier 4 — Temporary Ban (1–30 Days)
fields.value:
Issued for severe or sustained misconduct, repeated failure to correct behaviour after prior sanctions, or actions that cause direct harm to the community.

**Offences:**

- Three or more mutes with no sustained behavioural improvement
- Malicious impersonation of staff, a bot (Noxx, Cattito, Xyron), or another member
- Doxxing threats, dox teasing, or implying possession of private member information
- Sharing extremist-adjacent or hate-adjacent content after prior warnings
- Coordinating, participating in, or recruiting for a raid or mass harassment campaign
- Sustained cross-channel targeted harassment of a specific member
- Repeatedly undermining staff authority — public backtalk campaigns or proxy lobbying
- Providing false information to staff during an active moderation review
- Leaking server content — mod logs, staff discussions, ticket conversations, bot configs — externally

fields.name: Ban Duration Scale
fields.value:
``` First offence — moderate severity      →  1 to 3 days First offence — high severity          →  7 to 14 days Second temporary ban (any cause)       →  14 to 30 days Third temporary ban                    →  Automatic Tier 5 — Permanent Ban ```
**Recidivism rule:** Reoffending within **30 days** of returning from any temporary ban is automatic escalation to the next tier, regardless of the new offence's severity. Returning and immediately breaking the rules again is treated as a pattern, not an isolated incident.

author.name: Punishment Guide — Page 1 of 10 · Core Principles

footer.text: TSHE Punishment Guide · Page 1 of 10 · Use the page index below to jump to any section. • tshe.f34rless.xyz/punish

fields.name: Core Principles
fields.value:
- **6-month rolling record.** Warnings expire after 6 months without further violations. Only active warnings count toward escalation.
- **Ignorance is never a defence.** Enforcement proceeds regardless of whether you claim to have read the rules.
- **Impact determines severity.** Jokes, irony, sarcasm, and accidents are judged by their impact — not your intent.
- **First offenses get leniency.** A member with no prior record receives a warning or verbal correction for most first-time minor infractions. History compounds, but everyone starts clean.
- **Loophole attempts escalate penalties.** Any "grey area" argument, technicality claim, or "it doesn't say that specifically" response escalates to the highest tier available for that offence.
- **No second chances for zero-tolerance violations.** No account age, server standing, relationship, or personal circumstance changes this. Ever.
- **Staff decisions are final.** Disagreement is not grounds for escalation. The appeal system is.

fields.name: Tier Overview
fields.value:
```
Tier 1  →  Verbal Reminder / Minor Timeout (1–5 min)
Tier 2  →  Formal Warning (expires in 6 months)
Tier 3  →  Temporary Mute (30 min – 24 hr)
Tier 4  →  Temporary Ban (1–30 days)
Tier 5  →  Permanent Ban (appealable for staff error)
Zero    →  Bypasses all tiers — instant Tier 5, no appeal
```

Staff may skip tiers upward based on severity. First offences may land at higher tiers if the conduct warrants it. Tier skipping is always documented.

author.name: Punishment Guide — Page 2 of 10 · Tier 1 & Tier 2

footer.text: TSHE Punishment Guide · Page 2 of 10 · tshe.f34rless.xyz/punish

fields.name: Tier 1 — Deletion & Minor Timeout (1–5 Minutes)
fields.value:
Reserved for isolated, low-level disruptions on a first occurrence. **Repetition after a staff correction escalates to Tier 2.**

**Offences:**

- Spam or flooding — 4 or more identical/near-identical messages within 30 seconds
- Excessive rapid emoji, sticker, or GIF use past the threshold
- Wrong channel posting with no prior correction on record
- Blank, filler, or meaningless messages that disrupt channel flow
- Missing spoiler tags on content that requires them
- Accidental staff ping with an immediate and genuine acknowledgment

**Outcome:** Content deleted. 1–5 minute Discord timeout applied. Verbally noted. Second occurrence in the same session: escalates to Tier 2.

fields.name: Tier 2 — Formal Warning (6-Month Rolling)
fields.value:
Issued for first-time violations that exceed minor disruption, or any Tier 1 repetition after staff correction. **Formal warnings expire after 6 months without further violations.**

**Offences:**

- Targeted rudeness or dismissive behaviour toward any member

- Uncorrected profile or nickname violations after a staff request
- Unauthorised staff or role pings
- First instance of mini-modding without staff authority
- Bot or voice misuse after a Tier 1 correction
- Continuing a behaviour after a direct staff instruction to stop

**Outcome:** Formal warning logged via Noxx with 6-month expiry. DM sent. Two active warnings trigger Tier 3 review. Three or more active warnings accelerate all future escalations.

footer.text: Rules apply to all members at all times. Ignorance is never a valid defence. • hq.f34rless.xyz/rules

fields.name: E1 · Staff Authority & Compliance
fields.value:
- Staff members and the server owner hold **final, absolute, and binding authority** over all moderation decisions, enforcement actions, and rule interpretations within f34rless.hq. There is no community vote, no peer appeal, no "someone else said it was okay" exception, and no debate period.
- Publicly disputing, arguing with, backtalking, sarcastically complying with, mocking, or encouraging others to contest a moderation decision or staff instruction results in immediate escalation of the underlying penalty. The appeal system is the sole mechanism for dispute.
- Failure to comply with a direct staff instruction — including but not limited to stopping a behaviour, changing a nickname or profile, moving channels, leaving a voice channel, or providing information relevant to an active moderation review — results in escalating action starting with a formal warning and potentially reaching a ban for continued non-compliance.
- Staff may issue preemptive moderation actions — including mutes, kicks, temporary bans, and permanent bans — when they reasonably believe a member poses a risk to the community based on credible evidence, intelligence, or prior patterns. Preemptive actions are reviewable through the appeal system only.
- Staff directives issued in a channel, thread, forum post, voice channel, or DM carry equal authority regardless of the medium through which they are delivered.

fields.name: E2 · Mini-Modding
fields.value:
- Only designated f34rless.hq staff members with the appropriate permission level may enforce server rules, issue warnings, issue punishments, or take moderation actions. No other member has this authority.
- Calling out, warning, threatening, intimidating, lecturing, instructing, or attempting to sanction or punish other members for perceived rule violations without staff authorisation is classified as mini-modding and is prohibited.
- Mini-modding results in a formal warning on first offence and escalates to a mute on repetition. If a mini-modding pattern continues after two corrections, a temporary ban is applied.
- If you believe a rule has been violated, use the server's designated report system — do not confront, argue with, or attempt to correct the member you believe is in violation. Directing other members to "read the rules" or "stop breaking rules" in public channels is also classified as mini-modding.

fields.name: F1 · Bot Rules
fields.value:
- Abusing, spamming, exploiting, or intentionally overloading bot commands or bot systems — including but not limited to Noxx, Cattito, Xyron, and any other bots operating within f34rless.hq — to disrupt channels, harass members, or degrade server performance is prohibited.
- Attempting to manipulate, break, crash, reverse-engineer, exploit bugs in, socially-engineer, or gain unauthorised access to any bot system or its underlying infrastructure is prohibited and results in a permanent ban with no appeal.
- Impersonating any f34rless.hq-operated bot — Noxx, Cattito, Xyron, or any other — through name, avatar, responses, or behaviour is treated identically to staff impersonation and penalised accordingly.
- Discovering and exploiting a bot bug rather than responsibly reporting it in the designated bug report channel is a zero-tolerance offence resulting in immediate permanent ban. Responsible disclosure through the proper channel is always the correct path.

fields.name: G1 · Appeals (Part 1)
fields.value:
- ALL appeals must be submitted exclusively through the official appeal system at **https://zepp.noxxbot.com/appeals/1466990155020898413**. Appeals submitted through any other channel — DMs, tickets, public channels, third-party platforms, or proxy submissions — are automatically voided and the underlying penalty may be extended.
- Appeals must be calm, factual, concise, and focused on demonstrating a documented staff error. Hostile, demanding, accusatory, emotionally manipulative, or threatening submissions are denied immediately without review and result in permanent appeal blacklisting.
- Providing false information, fabricated evidence, misleading statements, or manipulative framing in an appeal submission results in a **permanent appeal blacklist** covering all cases for the appellant with no reinstatement possible.

fields.name: G1 · Appeals (Part 2)
fields.value:
- Arguing a case publicly — in any f34rless.hq channel, thread, forum, or voice channel — instead of using the appeal system results in immediate denial of any pending appeal and escalation of the penalty being discussed.
- Staff decisions on appeals are final. Re-submitting a closed appeal without new, verifiable evidence that was not available at the time of the original decision is ignored. Repeated resubmission results in a temporary ban for harassment of the appeals process.
- Appeals for hate speech (all forms), doxxing (including dox teasing), CSAM (any form), real-world threats (including death threats and threats of violence), and malware/phishing distribution are **never accepted under any circumstances**. These categories carry zero appeal rights. Advertising and ban evasion are appealable only for documented staff error.

fields.name: H1 · Gaming Channel Conduct
fields.value:
- Game-related trash talk and competitive banter are permitted only when it is clearly lighthearted, mutually engaged, and both parties are visibly comfortable. Once any participant expresses discomfort — verbally, in text, or through a reasonable behavioural signal — all trash talk between those parties stops immediately and permanently.
- Accusing members of cheating, hacking, exploiting, or violating game rules in public channels without verified, documented evidence is a conduct violation. Use the report system — do not make public accusations.
- Using unauthorised cheats, hacks, exploits, macros, automation tools, or any third-party software that provides unfair advantage in community-hosted game sessions results in removal from the session and a formal warning. Repeated violations result in a ban from all community gaming events.
- Game content, screenshots, clips, and discussion must stay in the designated gaming channels. Cross-posting gaming content into non-gaming channels is treated as off-topic posting under C2.

fields.name: C3 · Advertising & Self-Promotion
fields.value:
- Advertising, promoting, or distributing any Discord servers, bots, external services, websites, referral codes, affiliate links, social media handles, storefronts, products, brands, or commercial content without **explicit written staff approval obtained in advance** is prohibited and results in escalating action starting with a formal warning.
- Advertising disguised as natural conversation — casually "mentioning" a server, link, service, or product in a way that a reasonable person would identify as promotional — is treated identically to direct advertising. "I was just talking about it" is not a defence.
- Self-promotion of personal content (streaming channels, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, art commissions, writing, music, etc.) is permitted only in the designated self-promotion channels or with explicit prior staff approval for any other channel.
- Unsolicited DM advertising — sending server invites, promotional links, referral codes, or commercial content via DM to any TSHE member — is fully actionable at the server level regardless of where the DM recipient originally encountered the sender.

fields.name: C4 · Voice Channel Conduct
fields.value:
- Intentional audio distortion, voice changers with disruptive effect, soundboard abuse, ear-rape, sustained disruptive noise, mic spam, or any audio behaviour that disrupts the experience of other members in a voice channel is prohibited. First occurrence: immediate mute from voice. Repeated after correction: server mute.
- Do not play or transmit unsolicited audio — music, clips, sound effects, TTS messages, videos, or any audio content — through your microphone or streaming setup without the **explicit affirmative consent of every person currently in the voice channel**. A single objection means no audio.
- Recording voice channel conversations without the **explicit affirmative consent of every participant at the time of recording** is prohibited. Recordings made without full consent — if discovered — result in a permanent ban if shared externally or used to harass.
- Channel squatting — occupying a voice channel alone for extended periods after a staff request to vacate during high-traffic periods, or intentionally blocking others from joining by maintaining an active connection — results in escalating action starting with a formal warning.

fields.name: C5 · AI-Generated Content
fields.value:
- AI-generated content — text, images, audio, video, or any other media — is permitted in TSHE only where it fully complies with ALL existing server rules. There is no AI exception, exemption, or special category for any content standard.
- Using AI to flood channels with low-effort, repetitive, off-topic, or clearly automated content is classified as spam and penalised under C2.
- AI content that mimics, impersonates, or attempts to replicate any member, staff member, server bot, or public figure is prohibited. AI-generated impersonation used to deceive, harass, or defraud is a zero-tolerance offence.
- Generating AI content to bypass content filters, AutoMod rules, moderation review, or any server restriction is a zero-tolerance offence resulting in an **Immediate Permanent Ban with no appeal**.
- AI-generated child sexual abuse material (CSAM) in any form — including AI-generated depictions of minors in sexualised contexts, even if no real children are depicted — results in an **Immediate Permanent Ban, zero appeal, and a report to Discord Trust & Safety and the National Center for Missing & Exploited Children (NCMEC)**.

ALL appeals go exclusively through the official appeal system.

fields.name: D2 · Off-Server Conduct
fields.value:
- Misconduct targeting TSHE members on external platforms — including but not limited to other Discord servers, social media platforms, messaging apps, gaming platforms, forums, or any online or offline space — is actionable within TSHE when reported with verifiable evidence. The platform where the misconduct occurred does not matter.
- Coordinating, organising, leading, participating in, or recruiting for raids, harassment campaigns, brigades, targeted attacks, or coordinated abuse against TSHE or any of its members from any external platform results in an **Immediate Permanent Ban and a Discord Trust & Safety report**.
- Sharing, distributing, or making public any content from TSHE's internal or private channels — staff channels, moderation logs, ticket conversations, bot configuration data, private discussions — to any external party, public platform, or individual not authorised to view it results in an **Immediate Permanent Ban with no appeal**.

fields.name: C1 · SFW Standards — Absolute (Part 1)
fields.value:
- f34rless.hq is **strictly SFW (Safe For Work) in every channel at all times — including voice channels, stage channels, thread channels, forum posts, and DMs between f34rless.hq members**. There are no exceptions, no NSFW channels, no "18+" spaces, and no permitted NSFW contexts within the server. **Zero Tolerance: any NSFW content of any kind — imagery, text, audio, links, embeds, or attachments — results in an immediate permanent ban with no warning and no appeal. There is no first offence.**
- Prohibited content includes but is not limited to: sexually explicit or suggestive imagery, text, or audio; NSFW links, embeds, or attachments; sexual commentary, innuendo, or roleplay directed at any member; graphic gore, mutilation, or real-world violence footage; shock content, disturbing media, or content intended to disgust or traumatise. **This list is illustrative only — any content a reasonable person would consider sexual, mature, or unsafe-for-work is prohibited absolutely, with no de minimis or accidental-use exemption.**

fields.name: C1 · SFW Standards — Absolute (Part 2)
fields.value:
- NSFW content sent via DM to a f34rless.hq member is **fully actionable at the server level with penalties up to and including permanent ban**. Jurisdiction is determined by where the recipient met the sender — meeting on f34rless.hq means f34rless.hq rules apply to your DMs with that person. "It was a private message" is not a defence. **DM NSFW to any f34rless.hq member is treated as an immediate permanent ban offence with zero discretion.**
- AI-generated content of any type is held to the **identical standard** as manually created or sourced content. There is no AI exception for NSFW, gore, hateful, or otherwise prohibited material. **Using AI to generate, obfuscate, or bypass NSFW filters is treated as intentional evasion — immediate permanent ban, no appeal.**
- Content containing rapid flashing, strobing patterns, or visual effects known to trigger photosensitive epileptic seizures must not be shared in any channel. This includes GIFs, videos, embed previews, and forum content.
- Malware, executables, scripts, RATs, IP grabbers, credential harvesters, phishing links, or any harmful or malicious files shared in any channel, thread, forum post, or DM result in an **Immediate Permanent Ban, no appeal, and a Discord Trust & Safety report**.

fields.name: C2 · Channel Discipline & Spam
fields.value:
- Stay on topic in each channel according to its stated purpose. Off-topic posting after a staff redirection to the appropriate channel results in a formal warning. Continued off-topic posting after warning escalates to a mute.
- Spam is defined as 4 or more similar or identical messages within 30 seconds; excessive rapid emoji, sticker, GIF, or media use beyond reasonable community standards; message flooding; filler or nonsense posts; copy-paste repetition; and repeated unsolicited mentions or reply-pings.
- Zalgo text, invisible characters, zero-width characters, text walls exceeding 10 lines, excessive line breaks, Unicode abuse, or any formatting used to disrupt readability, damage user experience, or evade moderation filters is prohibited and results in immediate deletion and escalating action.
- Pinging `@everyone`, `@here`, any staff role, or the server owner without a verified legitimate need results in escalating action starting with a formal warning. Using reply-pings, indirect mentions, or any other technique to circumvent this restriction is treated as intentional evasion with doubled penalties.
- Spoilers must always use Discord's `||spoiler tag||` formatting. Untagged spoilers are deleted on sight. Repeated untagged spoilers after a warning result in escalating action starting with a formal warning.
- Mass-mentioning or mass-replying to multiple members or threads without legitimate cause is classified as spam and harassment simultaneously.

author.name: f34rless.hq Community Codex — Boundaries & Hate Speech (4/11)

footer.text: Rules apply to all members at all times. Ignorance is never a valid defence. • hq.f34rless.xyz/rules

fields.name: B2 · Boundaries & Consent
fields.value:
- When any member expresses discomfort with an ongoing interaction — in any form, in any channel (public or private), in any context — **all parties must stop the specific interaction immediately and permanently**.
- Any indication of discomfort, however informal, is sufficient. A clear "stop", a request to change the subject, "not comfortable with this", a change in tone, or any verbal or non-verbal signal that a reasonable person would recognise as discomfort triggers this rule. Formal wording, reports, or explicit statements are not required.
- Continuing or resuming an interaction after a member has expressed discomfort is **targeted harassment** and results in escalating moderation action starting with a formal warning. If the initial discomfort was stated twice, the penalty starts at a mute.
- Repeatedly initiating contact — messages, pings, reactions, mentions, reply-pings, follows, friend requests, thread invites, or any other form of communication — with members who have indicated they do not wish to engage results in escalating action. A single "leave me alone" is sufficient notice.
- Using alternative accounts, having friends relay messages, or any other indirect method to continue an interaction after being told to stop is treated as direct contact and escalates the penalty accordingly.

fields.name: B3 · Hate Speech & Discrimination (Part 1)
fields.value:
- Slurs, hate speech, or discriminatory language in any form — fully spelled out, censored (a***), dashes (a--), phonetic substitutes (s*lur), number-letter swaps (5lur), abbreviations, emoji representations, acronyms, or any disguised, encoded, or indirect variant — results in an **Instant Permanent Ban with zero appeal rights under any circumstances whatsoever**.
- Racism, homophobia, transphobia, biphobia, ableism, antisemitism, islamophobia, misogyny, misandry, or any targeted discrimination against any protected group, individual characteristic, or personal identity results in **immediate permanent removal with no appeal** regardless of claimed tone, intention, or context.

fields.name: B3 · Hate Speech & Discrimination (Part 2)
fields.value:
- "I was joking," "it's ironic," "it's a meme," "it's dark humour," "it's my culture," "I was quoting something," "no offence but," "I'm not X but," and "it was taken out of context" are **explicitly invalid defences in every case**. Content and conduct are assessed by their objective impact and reasonable interpretation — not by the sender's claimed intent.
- Dog-whistles, coded language, symbols, imagery, and references known to be associated with hate groups or extremist ideologies are subject to the same penalties as explicit hate speech. Claiming ignorance of what a symbol or term means does not constitute a defence.
- Hate speech or discriminatory content sent via DM to a f34rless.hq member is fully actionable at the server level with the same penalties as if it were posted in a public channel.

footer.text: Rules apply to all members at all times. Ignorance is never a valid defence. • hq.f34rless.xyz/rules

fields.name: B4 · Extremist Content
fields.value:
- Promoting, glorifying, endorsing, defending, sharing, referencing, or distributing extremist ideologies, hate group propaganda, terrorist content, or violent extremist material results in an **Immediate Permanent Ban and a Discord Trust & Safety report**.
- Sharing symbols, imagery, logos, flags, slogans, propaganda, music, or materials associated with designated hate groups, terrorist organisations, or extremist movements is prohibited regardless of claimed educational, historical, academic, journalistic, ironic, or artistic intent.
- Recruiting members toward extremist ideologies, hate groups, violent movements, or harmful organisations results in a **permanent ban, immediate report to Discord Trust & Safety, and referral to relevant authorities where applicable**.
- Expressing support for, defence of, or sympathy with known extremist ideologies, terrorist acts, or hate-group actions — including but not limited to Nazism, fascism, white supremacy, neo-Nazism, religious extremism, and violent ideologies — is treated as promotion.

fields.name: B5 · Drama, Toxicity & Negative Conduct
fields.value:
- Political debate, extremist rhetoric, divisive ideological commentary, hate-adjacent discussion, and inflammatory religious debate have no place in any public f34rless.hq channel. There is no "civil discussion" exception, no "both sides" framing, and no designated channel for these topics.
- Baiting arguments, sealioning, JAQing off (Just Asking Questions), concern trolling, manufacturing conflict, deliberately steering conversations toward controversy, or intentionally derailing constructive discussion results in escalating action starting with a formal warning.
- Spreading rumours, false statements, defamatory content, slander, gossip, or unsubstantiated claims about members, staff, the server, or server operations — inside or outside f34rless.hq — is prohibited. If the statement is verifiably false, intent to harm is presumed.
- Venting, complaining about, or publicly disputing individual moderation decisions in public channels instead of using the official appeal system results in automatic escalation of the penalty being discussed. The appeal system is the sole dispute mechanism.
- Public call-outs, drama-sourcing, "exposing" threads, or encouraging community outrage against any member or staff is prohibited. Issues with other members go through the report system — not public channels.

fields.name: A5 · No Loopholes — Comprehensive Policy (Part 1)
fields.value:
- Bypassing, circumventing, or attempting to evade any server rule through technical wording, "grey area" framing, cultural context, claimed ignorance, artistic expression, "ironic" posting, or creative interpretation of any kind automatically escalates the applicable penalty to its **maximum available tier**. There is no warning for loophole attempts.
- Staff may take moderation action against any behaviour that is disruptive, harmful, threatening, or detrimental to the community even if not explicitly listed in these rules. The rulebook is exhaustive in its scope, not in its wording. "It doesn't say that specifically" is not and will never be a valid defence.
- Arguing that a specific action is not listed verbatim in the rules is itself classified as a loophole attempt and is treated as an independent violation in addition to the original infraction.

fields.name: A5 · No Loopholes — Comprehensive Policy (Part 2)
fields.value:
- Repeated loophole attempts, technicality arguments, or "lawyering" of the rules after multiple corrections are classified as deliberate bad-faith conduct and result in a **permanent ban with no appeal**.
- Any staff member may make a binding determination that a behaviour constitutes a rules violation. That determination stands unless overturned through the official appeal system. There is no debate period, no community vote, and no "second opinion" process.

fields.name: B1 · Anti-Harassment (Part 1)
fields.value:
- Bullying, targeted insults, personal attacks, derogatory name-calling, hostile behaviour, or any communication intended to demean, distress, or provoke any member is strictly prohibited regardless of the relationship between the parties.
- Death threats, threats of violence, encouragement of self-harm or suicide, or violent intimidation directed at any person — inside or outside f34rless.hq, in any channel or DM — results in an **Instant Permanent Ban, no warning, no appeal, and a report to Discord Trust & Safety and relevant authorities**.
- Subtle, persistent, or indirect harassment — sustained trolling, rumour-spreading, social exclusion campaigns, repeated low-level provocation, microaggressions, sealioning, or bad-faith questioning — is penalised identically to direct harassment. "I was just joking," "it was banter," and "I didn't mean anything by it" are explicitly invalid defences.

fields.name: B1 · Anti-Harassment (Part 2)
fields.value:
- Harassment conducted through reactions, stickers, GIFs, emoji, quote-replies, reply-pings, indirect mentions, nicknames, voice channel activity, or any other Discord feature is fully actionable. The medium does not change the nature of the violation.
- Cyberstalking — following a member across channels, persistently monitoring their activity, or using information about their behaviour to harass or intimidate them — results in escalating action starting at a temporary ban and reaching permanent for repetition.
- If staff determines that a pattern of behaviour constitutes harassment, that determination is final and binding. The target's feeling of being harassed is sufficient evidence — formal complaints or specified wording are not required.

footer.text: Rules apply to all members at all times. Ignorance is never a valid defence. • hq.f34rless.xyz/rules

fields.name: A3 · Nicknames, Usernames & Profiles (Part 1)
fields.value:
- All names, nicknames, display names, and profile content (avatar, banner, bio, About Me, and pronoun fields) must be mentionable, readable, and free of offensive, discriminatory, impersonating, hateful, sexually suggestive, or NSFW language, imagery, or symbolism in any form.
- Invisible characters, Unicode manipulation, zero-width characters, homoglyph substitution, Zalgo text, excessive symbols, or any technique used to evade mentionability, sorting, AutoMod filters, or staff moderation is prohibited. Violation results in an immediate forced change plus a formal warning. Repeat or intentional evasion escalates directly to a ban.
- Impersonating any staff member, server owner, server bot (Noxx, Cattito, Xyron), other member, or known public figure via name, avatar, profile, or communication style results in escalating action starting at a formal warning and reaching permanent ban based on severity and intent to deceive.

fields.name: A3 · Nicknames, Usernames & Profiles (Part 2)
fields.value:
- Profile content found to contain hate speech, extremist symbols, slurs, doxxing, NSFW imagery, or threats results in the same penalty as if that content were posted in a channel — including immediate permanent ban for zero-tolerance categories.
- Staff may require a profile change at any time for any reason consistent with these rules. Failure to comply within the timeframe given results in escalating action starting with a formal warning and may include removal from the server pending compliance.

fields.name: A4 · Privacy & Doxxing (Part 1)
fields.value:
- Sharing, threatening to share, or implying the ability to share any personally identifying information — real names, home addresses, phone numbers, workplaces, schools, photographs, IP addresses, email addresses, social media accounts, financial information, medical information, or any other data that could identify, locate, or contact a person — without **explicit, documented, affirmative consent** from the subject results in an **Immediate Permanent Ban with zero appeal rights**.
- Dox teasing — threatening, implying, hinting, joking about, or suggesting that you hold private information about another person — carries the **identical penalty** to actual doxxing. There is no distinction between "I will post it" and "I could post it."
- Leaking, sharing, or distributing any internal f34rless.hq content — staff channels, moderation logs, ticket transcripts, bot configurations, private discussions, or any non-public server communication — to any external party or public channel results in an **Immediate Permanent Ban and a Discord Trust & Safety report**.

fields.name: A4 · Privacy & Doxxing (Part 2)
fields.value:
- Sharing screenshots of private conversations (DMs, group chats, or any non-public communication) without the **explicit documented consent of all parties depicted** is a privacy violation regardless of the content shown, the relationship between parties, or the context in which the screenshot is shared.
- Deepfakes, voice clones, AI-generated impersonations, or manipulated media designed to expose, target, harass, or misrepresent any member are treated as privacy violations and may be escalated to doxxing penalties depending on the content and intent.

fields.name: A1 · Discord ToS & Age Requirements
fields.value:
- All members must comply with Discord's Terms of Service and Community Guidelines at all times. Any ToS violation committed within f34rless.hq is a direct server rule violation and results in immediate moderation action, up to and including permanent removal.
- You must be **13 or older** to use Discord. Misrepresenting, implying, or suggesting any age below 13 in any form — stated age, username, bio, conversation topics, media consumption, or behaviour — results in an **Immediate Permanent Ban, no appeal, and a report to Discord Trust & Safety**.
- Age misrepresentation that causes or risks exposing minors to age-restricted content, adult conversation, or NSFW material results in an **Immediate Permanent Ban, no appeal, and a report to relevant authorities**.
- Soliciting age information from other members for purposes of determining minor status is prohibited unless you are f34rless.hq staff acting in an official moderation capacity.

fields.name: A2 · Alternate Accounts & Account Security
fields.value:

Passive observation — reading messages without participating — is treated identically to active participation.

- Using alternate accounts to evade rate limits, slowmode, channel restrictions, mutes, temporary bans, or any other active restriction is a zero-tolerance offence carrying an **Immediate Permanent Ban of all associated accounts**.
- Operating multiple accounts to manipulate polls, votes, giveaways, competitions, event outcomes, or server statistics results in permanent disqualification and a ban of all involved accounts.

embeds.description:
**What is zero-tolerance?**
Zero-tolerance offences result in an **immediate permanent ban** with no prior warning and (for most) no appeal rights. These are:
• Hate speech & slurs (any form, any intent)
• CSAM (any form — sharing, requesting, referencing, generating)
• Doxxing & dox teasing
• Real-world threats of violence or harm
• Malware & phishing distribution
No context, joke, irony, or accident defence changes this. Appeals are accepted only for documented staff error (misidentification, false report, technical malfunction).

**Do warnings expire?**
Yes. Warnings **expire after 6 months** without any further violations. After 6 clean months, the warning no longer counts toward escalation. If you receive a new warning before the 6 months are up, the expiry clock restarts for all active warnings.
Expired warnings remain logged for reference but do not affect tier escalation.

**How do I report someone?**
Use the server's report system. Do NOT:
• Confront the violator in public channels
• Attempt to moderate or warn them yourself (this is mini-modding)
• Start public arguments or callouts
Gather evidence (screenshots, message links) and submit it through the official reporting channel. Staff will review and take appropriate action.
For urgent issues (threats, CSAM, doxxing), ping staff directly or open a ticket.

**Does off-server conduct matter?**
Yes. Misconduct targeting TSHE members on external platforms is actionable when reported with verifiable evidence. This includes:
• Harassment of TSHE members in other servers, group chats, or platforms
• Coordinating raids or harassment campaigns against TSHE
• Sharing private TSHE server content externally
The platform does not matter. The connection to TSHE members is what establishes jurisdiction.

**What happens if I break a rule?**
It depends on the severity:
• **Minor first offense** (off-topic, accidental spam, etc.): Tier 1 — verbal reminder or minor timeout
• **Moderate first offense** (rudeness, mini-modding, wrong channel after correction): Tier 2 — formal warning (expires in 6 months)
• **Severe first offense** (harassment, boundary violations): Tier 3+ — mute or temporary ban
• **Zero-tolerance** (hate speech, threats, doxxing, CSAM, malware): Immediate permanent ban
Warnings expire after 6 months without further violations.

**Can I DM other TSHE members?**
Yes, but all server rules apply to DMs sent to TSHE members. This means:
• No harassment, threats, or abuse via DM
• No unsolicited advertising or server invites via DM
• No NSFW content via DM
• No DMing staff to dispute moderation actions
"It was a private DM" is not a defence — where you met the person determines jurisdiction.

**How do I appeal a punishment?**
1. Go to https://zepp.noxxbot.com/appeals/1466990155020898413
2. Include your case number (from the DM you received when the action was taken)
3. Be calm, factual, and concise
4. Explain why you believe a staff error occurred
Appeals are reviewed by staff who were not involved in the original action.
❌ Do NOT DM staff about your appeal — this will void it.
❌ Do NOT argue your case in public channels — this will escalate the penalty.
Appeals for hate speech, CSAM, doxxing, real-world threats, and malware are never accepted.
🔗 **Full FAQ:** <https://tshe.f34rless.xyz/faq> · **Appeal guide:** <https://tshe.f34rless.xyz/docs>

**Can I use alternate accounts?**
Alt accounts are permitted as long as they do not evade moderation actions. Specifically:
• Alt accounts joining while a ban or mute is active = permanent ban of all associated accounts
• Passive observation on an alt during a ban = treated identically to active evasion
• Warnings issued to alt accounts are merged onto the primary account's record
• All rule violations on a shared account are attributed to the registered owner
There is no "fresh slate" on an alt account.

**What are the rules for AI-generated content?**
AI content is held to the same standards as any other content:
• No NSFW, hateful, or rule-violating AI content
• No flooding channels with low-effort AI content (classified as spam)
• No impersonating members, staff, or bots with AI
• Using AI to bypass filters or create prohibited material = zero-tolerance, immediate permanent ban
AI origin does not reduce the severity of a violation.

**What This Policy Covers**
f34rless.hq operates a **strict zero-tolerance policy** for all ableist language, hate speech, and conduct targeting individuals or groups based on disability — including but not limited to physical disabilities, cognitive disabilities, neurodivergent conditions (such as autism, ADHD, and dyslexia), and chromosomal conditions (such as Down syndrome).


This applies regardless of how it is framed — as a joke, insult, meme, "dark humour", casual language, or anything else.


Any language, content, or behaviour that demeans, attacks, threatens, dehumanises, or calls for harm against disabled individuals or groups results in an **immediate permanent ban with no prior warning**.


This is not tiered. This is not a first-warning situation. It is instant.'

**Examples of Zero-Tolerance Conduct**
- Ableist slurs — in any form, censored or not, phonetic or not, used "ironically" or not
- Statements calling for harm, violence, or death targeting disabled people (e.g. "kill autistic people", "Down syndrome people should not exist", or any similar phrasing)
- Content that dehumanises, mocks, or denies the dignity of individuals based on any disability or neurodivergent condition
- Using disability-related terminology as a generic insult (e.g. using diagnostic terms as slurs or pejoratives in any context)
- Sharing, reposting, or reacting positively to external content — images, videos, links, memes — that promotes ableist hate or ridicules disabled people
- Using coded, indirect, or "ironic" framing to deliver the same content (e.g. "just a joke", "no offence", "I'm not ableist but...", context-free slur use)
- DMs to f34rless.hq members containing any of the above — this is fully actionable at the server level'

**Immediate Permanent Ban — no prior warning, no tier process.**


Your account history, server standing, join date, and personal relationships with staff do not factor in at all. The ban is applied the moment the conduct is confirmed.

> ✅ Documented AutoMod false positive with clear evidence it was not a human action

Appeals must be calm, factual, and include verifiable evidence. Hostile, accusatory, or emotionally charged submissions are denied immediately without review.'

> • This policy exists to protect every disabled and neurodivergent member of f34rless.hq. This community is for everyone.'

**Before You Open a Ticket**

Please read the following before submitting a ticket. Tickets opened without reading this may be closed without a response.

> 📖 **Ticket Guide:** <https://hq.f34rless.xyz/tickets>

**✅ Good reasons to open a ticket:**
> • You need to report a user or incident to staff
> • You have a question that cannot be answered in a public channel
> • You are appealing an action taken against you — but **only via** https://zepp.noxxbot.com/appeals/1466990155020898413
> • You have a partnership, collaboration, or staff-related enquiry

**❌ Do not open a ticket for:**
> • Asking general questions already answered in the rules or FAQs
> • Disputing a moderation action publicly or pressure-testing staff
> • Reporting something you could report via the Discord report system
> • Pinging or rushing staff — all tickets are seen and handled in order

**📋 When you open a ticket, include:**
> • A clear description of the issue
> • Any relevant evidence (screenshots, message links, user IDs)
> • Your best attempt at a timeline of events

Staff will respond when available. Do not ping staff inside or outside the ticket. Pinging staff for ticket status results in automatic closure of the ticket and a formal warning.

-# f34rless.hq • Misuse of the ticket system results in a formal warning. Repeated misuse results in escalating action up to and including a permanent ban.

fields.name: Do warnings expire?
fields.value:
Yes. Warnings **expire after 6 months** without any further violations. After 6 clean months, the warning no longer counts toward escalation. If you receive a new warning before the 6 months are up, the expiry clock restarts for all active warnings.
Expired warnings remain logged for reference but do not affect tier escalation.

fields.name: What is zero-tolerance?
fields.value:
Zero-tolerance offences result in an **immediate permanent ban** with no prior warning and (for most) no appeal rights. These are:

• Hate speech & slurs (any form, any intent)
• CSAM (any form)
• Doxxing & dox teasing
• Real-world threats of violence or harm
• Malware & phishing distribution

No context, joke, irony, or accident defence changes this. Appeals accepted only for documented staff error.

fields.name: How do I appeal a punishment?
fields.value:
Submit at https://zepp.noxxbot.com/appeals/1466990155020898413

• Include your case number (from the DM you received)
• Be calm, factual, and concise
• Explain why you believe a staff error occurred

❌ Do NOT DM staff — this voids your appeal.
❌ Do NOT argue in public channels — this escalates the penalty.

fields.name: Can I DM other TSHE members?
fields.value:
Yes, but all server rules apply to DMs sent to TSHE members. This means:

• No harassment, threats, or abuse via DM
• No unsolicited advertising or server invites via DM
• No NSFW content via DM
• No DMing staff to dispute moderation actions

"It was a private DM" is not a defence.

fields.name: Does off-server conduct matter?
fields.value: Yes. Misconduct targeting TSHE members on external platforms is actionable when reported with verifiable evidence. This includes harassment in other servers/group chats, coordinating raids against TSHE, and sharing private TSHE content externally. The platform does not matter.

fields.name: How do I report someone?
fields.value:
Use the server's report system. Do NOT confront the violator, attempt to moderate them yourself, or start public arguments. Gather evidence (screenshots, message links) and submit through the official reporting channel.
For urgent issues (threats, CSAM, doxxing), ping staff directly or open a ticket.

fields.name: What happens for a first offense?
fields.value:
Depends on severity:

• **Minor** (off-topic, accidental spam) → Tier 1: verbal reminder or minor timeout
• **Moderate** (rudeness, mini-modding) → Tier 2: formal warning (expires in 6 months)
• **Severe** (harassment, boundary violations) → Tier 3+: mute or temporary ban
• **Zero-tolerance** (hate speech, threats, doxxing, CSAM, malware) → immediate permanent ban

fields.name: Can I use alt accounts?
fields.value: Alt accounts joining while a ban or mute is active = permanent ban of all associated accounts. Passive observation on an alt during a ban is treated identically to active evasion. Warnings on alts merge onto the primary record. No "fresh slate" on an alt.

fields.name: What about AI content?
fields.value: AI content is held to the same standards as any other content. No NSFW/hateful/rule-violating AI. No flooding with low-effort AI (classified as spam). No impersonating members or staff with AI. Using AI to bypass filters = zero-tolerance, immediate permanent ban.

**Homophobia & Anti-LGBT+ Hate — Zero Tolerance**

**What This Policy Covers**
f34rless.hq operates a **strict zero-tolerance policy** for all homophobic, transphobic, biphobic, and anti-LGBT+ conduct. This applies regardless of how it is framed — as a joke, opinion, meme, lyric, "just asking questions", or anything else.


Any language, content, or behaviour that demeans, attacks, threatens, dehumanises, or calls for harm against individuals or groups based on sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression results in an **immediate permanent ban with no prior warning**.


This is not tiered. This is not a first-warning situation. It is instant.'

**Examples of Zero-Tolerance Conduct**
- Homophobic, transphobic, or biphobic slurs — in any form, censored or not, phonetic or not, "ironic" or not
- Statements calling for harm, violence, or death against LGBT+ individuals or the broader community (e.g. "kill pride", "death to LGBT", or similar phrasing)
- Content that dehumanises, denies the validity of, or promotes hatred toward LGBT+ identities
- Slur-containing usernames, nicknames, avatars, or profile content directed at or targeting LGBT+ people
- Sharing, reposting, or reacting positively to external content — images, videos, links, memes — that promotes anti-LGBT+ hate
- Using coded, indirect, or "ironic" framing to deliver the same content (e.g. "just asking", "I'm not homophobic but...", "no offence", context-free slur references)
- DMs to f34rless.hq members containing any of the above — this is fully actionable at the server level'

**Penalty**
**Immediate Permanent Ban — no prior warning, no tier process.**


Your account history, server standing, join date, and personal relationships with staff do not factor in at all. The ban is applied the moment the conduct is confirmed.


This ban is **not appealable** unless you can demonstrate a documented staff error — for example, misidentification, false report, or technical malfunction. The following are **never** accepted as appeal grounds:


> ❌ "It was a joke."
> ❌ "I didn't mean it that way."
> ❌ "Someone else said it first."
> ❌ "I was quoting a song / meme / video."
> ❌ "I didn't know it was against the rules."
> ❌ General disagreement with the outcome.'

**Appeal Eligibility**
Appeals are accepted **only** in the following verified circumstances:


> ✅ Documented AutoMod false positive with clear evidence it was not a human action
> ✅ Proven account compromise — someone else posted on your account
> ✅ Demonstrable case of mistaken identity or misidentification by staff


If any of the above apply, submit your appeal at:

**https://zepp.noxxbot.com/appeals/1466990155020898413**


Appeals must be calm, factual, and include verifiable evidence. Hostile, accusatory, or emotionally charged submissions are denied immediately without review.'

**Additional Notes**
> • AutoMod may catch and flag this content automatically — automated flags are still reviewed by staff and confirmed before action is taken.
> • If you witness this conduct, report it immediately using the server report system. Do not engage or argue with the offending member.
> • This policy exists to protect every LGBT+ member of f34rless.hq. The community is inclusive and that will not change.'

-# f34rless.hq | This policy applies across all channels, DMs, voice, and off-server conduct reported to staff.

**Moderation Notes — Staff Reference**
Core enforcement principles for the f34rless.hq moderation team. All actions are logged and subject to internal review.

**Enforcement Principles**
> • Every moderation action is logged and reviewable by senior staff at any time.
> • **Impact determines severity.** Jokes, irony, and accidents are judged by their impact, not claimed intent.
> • **Active (unexpired) warnings compound severity.** Expired warnings (6+ months without incident) are logged but do not count toward escalation.
> • **Loophole attempts escalate the applicable penalty.**
> • Staff may act on any harmful or disruptive behaviour not explicitly listed in the rules.'

**Evidence Standards**
> • All actions must be documented with clear reasoning in the case note.
> • Screenshots, message links, or user IDs are required for external platform reports.
> • AI moderation flags are for review only — they do not result in punishment without staff confirmation.
> • Appeal evidence must be verifiable. Screenshots can be falsified; context and corroboration matter.'

**Appeal Handling**
> • Appeals are reviewed by staff **not involved in the original action**.
> • The only accepted dispute route is the official appeal system.
> • Public complaints, DM pressure, and proxy campaigns are disregarded and result in escalation.
> • Appeals for hate speech, CSAM, doxxing, real-world threats, and malware are **never accepted under any circumstances**.'

**Staff Conduct**
> • Staff who misuse moderation tools or act in bad faith are subject to internal disciplinary review by the server owner.
> • No staff member is above the rules — any staff can be actioned if community safety requires it.
> • When in doubt, escalate — do not guess on serious cases.
> • Preemptive actions are permitted to protect the community and are reviewable via appeal only.'

**Final Note**
f34rless.hq's moderation system exists to protect every member's experience. Members who participate in good faith and treat others with basic respect will rarely see anything beyond a Tier 1 correction.


*When in doubt about whether something is allowed — ask a staff member before posting.*'

-# f34rless.hq | All decisions are subject to internal review. Use the appeal system for disputes.

**Outside-Server Punishments & Staff Authority**

Staff may take moderation action (warning, mute, kick, temporary ban, or permanent ban) for behaviour that occurred outside this server when:
• A staff member was involved in the incident (for example, in DMs, other servers, or group chats).
• A member submits a report that credibly alleges off-server misconduct which impacts our community.

Such actions may be taken even if the evidence is not published publicly. This includes reports involving private messages, content in other servers, or staff-involved incidents.

Appeals: If you believe an action was incorrect, submit an appeal through the official appeals system at https://zepp.noxxbot.com/appeals/1466990155020898413. Appeals are handled by staff not involved in the original action.

> 📖 **Full punishment guide:** <https://hq.f34rless.xyz/punish>

Important: Do not DM staff to dispute a moderation action. Contacting staff directly about a case will normally result in the appeal being denied and may lead to further action.

**Profile Moderation — f34rless.hq Policy**
Our moderation team may review and take action against inappropriate content found anywhere on your Discord profile, not just your messages.

**What We Moderate**
> • **Usernames** — your Discord-wide handle
> • **Display names** — server-specific or global display names
> • **Profile bios / About Me** — any text in your profile description
> • **Avatars / profile pictures** — your current profile image
> • **Profile banners** — your account banner image
> • **Pronoun fields** — Discord allows custom text here; it is moderated identically to any other profile section'

**Content That May Result in Action**
This includes, but is not limited to:

> • **Impersonation** — of staff, members, bots, or public figures
> • **Hateful or discriminatory content** — racist, bigoted, or targeted language in any form
> • **NSFW or sexually explicit content** — explicit imagery or language anywhere on your profile
> • **Harassment or targeted abuse** — content directed at or intended to demean specific individuals
> • **Extreme gore or disturbing imagery** — avatars or banners containing graphic violence
> • **Malicious or scam-related content** — impersonation designed to deceive or defraud
> • **Rule bypass attempts** — any profile content intended to circumvent server rules'

**Possible Moderation Actions**
Severity determines the response. Actions may include, in escalating order:

> • **Warning** — formal record added to your case history
> • **Forced profile change** — you may be required to update the offending content before rejoining or interacting
> • **Mute** — temporary restriction from sending messages while the matter is resolved
> • **Kick** — removal from the server; you may rejoin after correcting your profile
> • **Ban** — temporary or permanent, depending on severity and history

As with all f34rless.hq enforcement, your full moderation history is reviewed on every case. Repeat violations escalate automatically.'

-# f34rless.hq | Profile moderation applies at all times, including during server inactivity. Use the appeal system for disputes.

**f34rless.hq Warning System — 6-Month Rolling Record**

**A1 · Warning Philosophy**
- f34rless.hq uses a **rolling 6-month warning system**. Each warning carries a weight that diminishes over time as you demonstrate good behaviour.
- Warnings **expire 6 months after issuance** provided no further moderation action occurs in that period. After 6 clean months, the warning no longer counts toward escalation.
- Your full moderation history is visible to all staff, but only **active (unexpired) warnings** count toward tier escalation. Expired warnings remain logged for reference only.
- If a new warning is issued before old ones expire, the expiry clock restarts — you must go 6 consecutive months without any new warnings to clear any.
- Major offences (hate speech, doxxing, CSAM, threats, advertising, malware) **bypass the warning system entirely** and result in immediate permanent action.
- Attempting to influence staff to reduce, remove, or informally dismiss a warning — via DM, in public, or through a third party — results in an additional warning and appeal disqualification.'

**A2 · Escalating Consequences**
Penalties scale with **active (unexpired) warnings** — warnings older than 6 months without further incidents do not count:

```
1 warn   →  Formal recorded warning (expires in 6 months)
2 warns  →  1-hour server mute
3 warns  →  6-hour server mute
4 warns  →  24-hour server mute
5 warns  →  3-day server mute
6 warns  →  7-day server mute
7 warns  →  14-day temporary ban (appealable)
8+ warns →  Permanent ban (staff error appeal only)
```

> 🔇 Major offences bypass this ladder entirely and result in immediate permanent action.'

**A3 · Warning Issuance & Stacking**
- Warnings are issued via Noxx and logged to your record instantly with a 6-month expiry timestamp.
- Staff may issue multiple warnings for a single incident if multiple rules were violated simultaneously. There is no cap on warnings issued in one incident.
- Severity of the offence may cause staff to skip tiers and apply a higher tier directly. Tier skipping is always documented.
- Warnings issued to alternate accounts are merged onto the primary account's record.
- Multiple violations across different rule categories in a single session are processed as a combined escalation event, not individually.'

**A4 · Conduct After a Warning**
- Warnings are final when issued. The correct response is to acknowledge and correct your behaviour.
- Arguing, disputing, or publicly complaining about a warning is treated as a **new violation** and results in an additional warning.
- Harassment of the warning-issuing staff member — in any channel, via DM, or externally — results in an **immediate mute and escalated warning count**.
- Submit a formal appeal at https://zepp.noxxbot.com/appeals/1466990155020898413 if you believe the warning was issued in error. Do not contact staff via DMs — this voids your appeal eligibility.
- 📖 **Full warning system documentation:** <https://hq.f34rless.xyz/docs>'
